name: background-dots
summary: Repeating dot pattern as a background, optionally over an image.

arguments.name: $color
accepts: one colour, or two for the diagonal variant, each a colour, currentColor, a system colour or a function such as var() or light-dark()

arguments.name: $size
accepts: dot radius: a length, or var(), env() or a calculation such as calc() or clamp()

arguments.name: $gutter
accepts: spacing between dots, in the same forms as $size
null, the default, for five times $size

arguments.name: $image
accepts: an image path to sit behind the dots, written unquoted unless it holds a space, a parenthesis or a quote, which are quoted
var(), url(), image-set() or a gradient, written as they are rather than wrapped in url()
